identityReview: Nicola Ferguson Sturgeon, born Irvine July 19, 1970; Glasgow LLB 1992 and professional diploma 1993, former solicitor. Scottish, not UK Westminster, parliamentarian from 1999; final Glasgow Southside term ended April 8, 2026. Deputy first minister from May 17, 2007, infrastructure portfolio September 5, 2012, SNP leadership November 14, 2014, first minister oath November 20; formal resignation March 28, 2023 distinct from February 15 announcement. Former officeholder and author; not current first minister/MSP or convicted person in Branchform.

Read official case page and full three-page Supreme Court press summary [2022] UKSC 31, November 23, 2022. Unanimous conclusion: absent modification of reserved matters, Holyrood lacks competence to legislate proposed referendum; Union and UK Parliament reserved. Explicitly a legal competence issue, not political judgment whether Scotland should be independent; 2014 authorization distinct. Summary itself notes only full judgment authoritative; did not audit full judgment or every cited precedent. No claim all possible future referendums forever prohibited.

Read full relevant ITV March 20, 2025 report with Police Scotland and COPFS statements: woman arrested June 11, 2023 not charged, no longer under investigation; inquiries concluded following prosecution-service direction. Not trial acquittal, conviction, or a report that all Branchform proceedings ended. Police procedural fact separate from Sturgeon’s own assertions about evidence. Murrell’s separate case not attributed to her; original confidential police statement/file not accessed.

Read publisher page for Frankly ebook ISBN 9781035040247: publication August 14, 2025, Macmillan imprint, memoir description. Publication date not necessarily first shop sale; STV search reports early sales August 11 with no embargo, so no claim nobody could buy before August 14. Publisher praise and memoir allegations not independent proof. Book itself and full later paperback revisions not read.
